columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the source document.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLASS
columns.description: Account class associated with the revenue adjustment schedule line account code.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the line is set to account the revenue adjustment schedule line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Ledger unique identifier.

columns.name: PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of revenue of the document line.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the revenue adjustment schedule in functional currency.

columns.name: CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS
columns.description: Accounting code unique identifier.

columns.name: POSTING_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Posting batch unique identifier.

columns.name: GL_POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the revenue is posted to the general ledger.

columns.name: LATEST_REC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the row is the latest record with an account class of receivable. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: REC_OFFSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the record is an unbilled receivables line paired with the revenue line of the revenue document. Possible values are Yes, No, or Null.

columns.name: COLLECTED_TAX_CCID
columns.description: Transaction distribution of a collected tax account class. This attribute is only used for deferred tax.

columns.name: REVENUE_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Revenue adjustment unique identifier.

columns.name: POST_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Journal entry posting unique identifier.

columns.name: RA_POST_LOOP_NUMBER

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments associated to the revenue adjustment schedule line.

columns.name: USER_GENERATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the user has created the entry manually. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: SLA event unique identifier.

columns.name: ROUNDING_CORRECTION_FLAG
